# Security policy

## Supported versions

FortiBar does not have a stable release yet. Security fixes are made on the `main` branch.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lauritsk/fortibar/security/advisories/new) instead.

Include the affected version or commit, reproduction steps, the expected impact, and any suggested fix. Remove passwords, VPN addresses, logs, and other private data from the report.
